maria: quick note 14 1 1 - found a broken anchor on the ZephyrXL card. catalog links to /models/zephyrxl#limits but card header is '## Sequence limits'. small but some blog posts use the old anchor.
sam: thanks, can you paste where the link lives?
maria: catalog index line 342 and a link in partners/benchmarks.md. also the SDK snippet under 'long-context tips' still uses generate() from older SDK.
leo: we should do three things: fix catalog link, add an anchor id shim on the card, and update the SDK snippet to responses.create.
jen: mkdocs supports the {#id} syntax, so add `### Limits {#limits}` under the header.
sam: I can open a tiny PR for that + snippet swap. proposed new snippet:
```python3
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-xl", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=512)
print(resp.output[0].content)  # raw response element
```
maria: add a one-line note about quantized variants having smaller effective context. keep it short.
leo: also create a redirect mapping so external anchors don't 404.
